summary: Iteration 5 tested Análise da Produção page (PorOF + Análise Mensal) and Orçamento per-line operations editor + conversion to OF. Backend: /api/producao/tempos and /api/producao/analise return well-formed data with all expected fields (taxa_conclusao, tempo_estimado/real, desvio_tempo, custo_estimado/real, desvio_custo). Frontend: nav-analise-producao routes to /analise-producao, header reads 'Análise da Produção', mode toggle works (analise-mode-of + analise-mode-mensal). PorOF view renders the OF table with Tempos/Custos sub-tabs (tempos-tab-tempo/custo), expanding an OF row shows its operations. Análise Mensal view fetches /producao/analise, renders a recharts bar chart (svg=3) and mensal-table with mensal-row-<mes>; toggling mensal-tab-tempo/custo correctly swaps the chart Bars (tempo_estimado/real <-> custo_estimado/real) and table columns (Tempo Estimado <-> Custo Estimado). Orçamento detail line operations editor works end-to-end: line-ops-toggle-0 opens line-ops-0, line-add-op-0 adds an operation row, save-orcamento-btn persists, and after page reload the custom op 'TEST_UI_OP' is still present alongside the existing Impressão op. HIGH PRIORITY BUG: the Convert-Quote-to-OF backend endpoint IGNORES the per-line roteiro customizations the user has just made — pytest test_orcamento_line_roteiro_persists_and_converts_to_of confirms that after PUT-ing roteiro=[TEST_IT5_OP, 7min/11min] and converting, the resulting OF.itens[0].operacoes contains the artigo's DEFAULT roteiro ('Impressão' 10/15 min) instead of the customized one. This breaks the very feature the user requested (edit operations/times per article line inside the Orçamento and have them carry into the OF).

critical.issue: Does NOT propagate orcamento.linhas[*].roteiro into the new OF.itens[*].operacoes. converter_orcamento() only copies artigo_id/artigo_nome/quantidade/tipo_personalizacao_* (server.py lines 989–999) and then build_of_itens() auto-loads the artigo's default roteiro because operacoes is empty (server.py lines 808–826). User-edited operations/times on a quote line are silently discarded on conversion.

action_items: Fix POST /api/orcamentos/{id}/converter in /app/backend/server.py: when building items from orc.linhas, translate l.get('roteiro', []) into the OF operacoes shape (OFOperacao with tempo_maquina/tempo_mao_obra in minutes, tempo_min sum, and custo_estimado computed via maquina_custo_hora + mao_obra.custo_hora) and pass it as it['operacoes'] so that build_of_itens does not overwrite it with the artigo's default roteiro. Reuse op_minutos_maquina/op_minutos_mao_obra helpers already present in server.py.
Add an integration test (already in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py::test_orcamento_line_roteiro_persists_and_converts_to_of) to your CI to prevent regression.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend converter_orcamento (server.py 979-1018) loses line roteiro customizations — the new editor in OrcamentoDetail.jsx is effectively a no-op for the final OF. Frontend save() correctly PUTs roteiro and it is correctly persisted on the orçamento document (verified via GET reload), but conversion ignores it.

AnaliseProducao.jsx is well structured (PorOF + Mensal sub-components, clear data-testid coverage). Minor: PorOF uses isCusto?7:9 colspan for empty state but the table has 8 columns when isCusto and 9 when not — colspan is fine for 'no data' rendering but if you ever switch sub-tab while empty, the colspan in row 162 should match (currently 7/9 vs the actual 8/9). Cosmetic only.
Mensal chart uses Recharts <Bar dataKey={isCusto ? 'custo_estimado' : 'tempo_estimado'}> — clean. Empty state (mensal-empty data-testid) is handled.
Layout.jsx nav-analise-producao route correct; Tempos.jsx removed (confirmed not imported anywhere).

success_rate.backend: 67% (2/3 iteration-5 tests pass; 1 fails by design exposing the converter bug)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all targeted UI flows verified: nav, header, PorOF + sub-tabs, Mensal chart+table+sub-tabs, line ops editor add/save/reload persistence)

seed_data_creation: test_iteration5 may create a TEST_IT5_Cliente quote and a converted OF; both are deleted at teardown if delete endpoints exist (best-effort).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes converter_orcamento to pass line roteiro into OF operacoes, re-run: `export $(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5.py -v`. The third test test_orcamento_line_roteiro_persists_and_converts_to_of should pass once the converter copies tempo_maquina (7) and TEST_IT5_OP into the resulting OF.itens[0].operacoes[0]. Note: the GET /api/ordens-fabrico response uses 'itens' (not 'linhas') with each item having an 'operacoes' array — keep that shape. Frontend already works correctly and needs no changes.
rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/backend/server.py the converter_orcamento endpoint (line 979) constructs items only from {artigo_id, artigo_nome, quantidade, tipo_personalizacao_*}. It then calls build_of_itens (line 798) which, finding no 'operacoes' on the item, falls back to fetching the artigo's default roteiro from db.artigos (line 808-826). The line-level roteiro that the user customized on the orçamento line is in orc.linhas[i].roteiro and is correctly persisted there, but is never read inside converter_orcamento. REPRODUCTION: (1) POST /api/orcamentos with a line; (2) PUT it with linhas[0].roteiro=[{nome:'X', maquina_id:..., tempo_maquina:7, ...}]; (3) GET /api/orcamentos/{id} → shows correct roteiro; (4) POST /api/orcamentos/{id}/converter → returned OF.itens[0].operacoes contains the artigo's default roteiro instead. MITIGATION: In converter_orcamento, when assembling each item, also build an 'operacoes' list from l.get('roteiro', []) (mapping op.tempo_maquina/op.tempo_maquina_unidade → minutes via op_minutos_maquina, same for mao_obra) with custo_estimado computed from maquina + mao_obra hourly costs, and pass it via the item dict so that build_of_itens preserves it (its line 808 branch only auto-loads when operacoes is falsy).
